biggest_catch: Two strict filters cut most people out: you must live in Maine, New Hampshire, or Vermont, and you must not have held a Bar Harbor Bank & Trust consumer checking account within the last 15 months. The bonus pays on or about 1/15/27 (up to ~3.5 months after opening).
catches: Open a new Simple Checking (or other consumer checking) account between 9/1/26 and 10/31/26 with offer code C10926A02ONLINE; if opening in a branch, present the original postcard/coupon containing the offer code.

Have at least one direct deposit of $250 or more posted by 12/31/26; qualifying DD = employer/corporate/government/retirement-benefits deposits; person-to-person (PayPal, Venmo, Zelle), teller/ATM deposits do not count.
Bonus of $200 is credited on or about 1/15/27; account must be open and in good standing then.
One offer per household; only one account-opening promotion ever per customer; new-to-BHBT consumer checking only (no consumer checking within the last 15 months); employees not eligible.
Simple Checking is a non-interest-bearing account; fees could reduce earnings.
Bonus is reported as interest on Form 1099-MISC.
